title: CI triage report
description: What the triage agent returns for one CI run (claude -p --json-schema).

runId.description: The GitHub Actions run id that was triaged.

verdict.description: green: no failure needs an owner action (expected known-bug failures are normal). needs-attention: at least one does. infrastructure: the run broke before tests could report. inconclusive: the report could not be read or classified.

summary.description: Two or three sentences for a person.

expectedKnownBugFailures.description: Tests that failed as expected under a knownBug() marker.

failures.description: Failures that need an owner action, grouped by cause.

tests.description: Every test of this cause, one per item, as analyze_ci_run names it (file:line title). Never a count or a pattern such as 'all 5 in cart.spec.ts': the owner needs to see which tests, and a failure left out of the report is invisible.

knownBugId.description: SD-xxx or DJ-xxx when the cause is catalogued.

evidence.description: The one line that decides the category.

action.description: What the owner should do next.
